claim_zh: 意识改变时并行核查氧合、灌注、血糖、药物和惊厥因素，并评估颅内恶化。
claim_en: When mentation changes, assess oxygenation, perfusion, glucose, drugs and seizures alongside intracranial deterioration.
locators: Initial physiologic targets pp.19–20; neurologic/ICP assessment pp.21–27 | Recommendations 5,8,11,13,18; physiology, imaging, coagulation, TBI exception, temperature

claim_zh: 避免低氧和低血压；颅内监测、重复影像及手术评估结合伤情、趋势与神经外科判断，不能由单张 CT 自动触发。
claim_en: Avoid hypoxaemia and hypotension. Monitoring, repeat imaging and surgical review depend on injury, trajectory and neurosurgical assessment, not one CT alone.
locators: Initial physiologic targets pp.19–20; neurologic/ICP assessment pp.21–27 | Recommendations 5,8,11,13,18; physiology, imaging, coagulation, TBI exception, temperature

claim_zh: 连续记录 GCS 的 E/V/M、瞳孔与四肢反应，同时记录全身生理。新变化比“已经做过 CT”更能提示重新评估。
claim_en: Record GCS components, pupils and limb responses with systemic physiology. New changes require reassessment even after CT.
locators: Initial physiologic targets pp.19–20; neurologic/ICP assessment pp.21–27 | Recommendations 5,8,11,13,18; physiology, imaging, coagulation, TBI exception, temperature

claim_zh: 疑似张力性气胸合并血流动力学不稳或严重呼吸受损时，团队不应为等待影像延误紧急处理；不要求所有经典体征齐全。
claim_en: Suspected tension pneumothorax with haemodynamic instability or severe respiratory compromise warrants urgent team action without waiting for imaging or every classic sign.
locators: Pleural injuries; chest wall injuries; conditional recommendations | Physiology; respiratory failure; SSRF indications and timing | 1.4 chest; 1.5 haemorrhage and imaging; updates checked at source

claim_zh: 积血量不是唯一决定因素。把生理变化、通气需求、积血进展和复查能力一起交给专科评估；胸壁固定也需结合稳定性、移位和呼吸负担。
claim_en: Volume alone does not decide management. Integrate physiology, ventilation needs, progression and follow-up capacity with specialist review. Fixation also depends on stability, displacement and respiratory burden.
locators: Pleural injuries; chest wall injuries; conditional recommendations | Physiology; respiratory failure; SSRF indications and timing | 1.4 chest; 1.5 haemorrhage and imaging; updates checked at source

claim_zh: 同时追踪患者氧合和灌注、引流量的逐小时记录、管路状态。病情下降时不等待凑满某个数字阈值。
claim_en: Track oxygenation and perfusion, hourly drainage and tube/system status together. Do not wait for a numerical threshold when physiology declines.
locators: Pleural injuries; chest wall injuries; conditional recommendations | Physiology; respiratory failure; SSRF indications and timing | 1.4 chest; 1.5 haemorrhage and imaging; updates checked at source

claim_zh: 阴性 FAST 不能结束出血风险评估，也不能排除肠、系膜或腹膜后损伤。症状变化时重新查体和更新信息需求。
claim_en: Negative FAST does not close bleeding assessment or exclude bowel, mesenteric or retroperitoneal injury. Re-examine and update information needs as symptoms change.
locators: 1.4 chest; 1.5 haemorrhage and imaging; updates checked at source | NOM eligibility, monitoring and access to rescue intervention | Diagnostic uncertainty, serial examination and repeat assessment | Risk-based follow-up during nonoperative management

claim_zh: 选择非手术路径需综合生理稳定、无其他需手术的损伤、连续监测及及时救援能力；不是凭影像分级单独决定。
claim_en: Nonoperative care requires physiologic stability, no other injury requiring surgery, serial monitoring and timely rescue capacity; imaging grade alone is insufficient.
locators: 1.4 chest; 1.5 haemorrhage and imaging; updates checked at source | NOM eligibility, monitoring and access to rescue intervention | Diagnostic uncertainty, serial examination and repeat assessment | Risk-based follow-up during nonoperative management

claim_zh: 腹痛范围、腹膜刺激征、灌注与实验室趋势恶化时，重新评估延迟显现的损伤；重复 CT 与介入或手术评估按病情和资源决定。
claim_en: Worsening pain, peritoneal findings, perfusion or laboratory trends prompt review for evolving injury; repeat CT and procedural assessment depend on physiology and resources.
locators: 1.4 chest; 1.5 haemorrhage and imaging; updates checked at source | NOM eligibility, monitoring and access to rescue intervention | Diagnostic uncertainty, serial examination and repeat assessment | Risk-based follow-up during nonoperative management

claim_zh: 损伤名称不等于当前休克原因；结合机制、连续灌注、全身出血来源和复苏反应更新风险。
claim_en: An injury label does not establish the current cause of shock. Update risk using mechanism, serial perfusion, all bleeding sources and response to resuscitation.
locators: Recommendations 5,8,11,13,18; physiology, imaging, coagulation, TBI exception, temperature | Initial physiologic targets pp.19–20; neurologic/ICP assessment pp.21–27 | 1.4 chest; 1.5 haemorrhage and imaging; updates checked at source

claim_zh: 出血控制、复苏、保温、凝血评估和资源启动相互衔接。不稳定且无反应的患者不应因 CT 延误必要的出血控制。
claim_en: Bleeding control, resuscitation, warming, coagulation assessment and resource activation are coordinated. CT should not delay necessary haemorrhage control in an unstable nonresponder.
locators: Recommendations 5,8,11,13,18; physiology, imaging, coagulation, TBI exception, temperature | Initial physiologic targets pp.19–20; neurologic/ICP assessment pp.21–27 | 1.4 chest; 1.5 haemorrhage and imaging; updates checked at source

claim_zh: 不能把无脑损伤条件下的允许性低血压策略套用到重型 TBI。意识下降同时核对低氧、休克和药物等混杂因素，避免由 GCS 单独归因。
claim_en: Do not apply permissive hypotension intended for patients without brain injury to severe TBI. Assess hypoxia, shock and drug confounders when mentation falls; GCS alone does not establish cause.
locators: Recommendations 5,8,11,13,18; physiology, imaging, coagulation, TBI exception, temperature | Initial physiologic targets pp.19–20; neurologic/ICP assessment pp.21–27 | 1.4 chest; 1.5 haemorrhage and imaging; updates checked at source

claim_zh: xABCDE 是共同语言；危及生命的出血与其他立即威胁由团队并行组织，不是做完一项才允许开始下一项。
claim_en: xABCDE provides shared language. Teams coordinate life-threatening bleeding and other immediate threats in parallel, rather than requiring one task to finish before another starts.
locators: xABCDE framework; public summary only | 1.4 chest; 1.5 haemorrhage and imaging; updates checked at source | Recommendations 5,8,11,13,18; physiology, imaging, coagulation, TBI exception, temperature

claim_zh: 疑似张力生理结合临床严重度；FAST 只提供有限的液体信息，不能单独关闭出血假设。
claim_en: Assess suspected tension physiology using clinical severity; FAST offers limited fluid information and cannot independently close the bleeding hypothesis.
locators: xABCDE framework; public summary only | 1.4 chest; 1.5 haemorrhage and imaging; updates checked at source | Recommendations 5,8,11,13,18; physiology, imaging, coagulation, TBI exception, temperature

claim_zh: 报告变化、未解问题和下一复评时点；检查后、干预后和转运后重新对比。
claim_en: Report changes, unresolved questions and the next reassessment point; compare again after tests, interventions and transport.
locators: xABCDE framework; public summary only | 1.4 chest; 1.5 haemorrhage and imaging; updates checked at source | Recommendations 5,8,11,13,18; physiology, imaging, coagulation, TBI exception, temperature

claim_zh: 高能量机制和持续灌注异常需要考虑骨盆及其他隐匿出血来源；避免反复诱发骨盆不稳的检查。
claim_en: High-energy mechanism and persistent perfusion abnormalities warrant assessment of pelvic and other occult bleeding sources; avoid repeated provocative pelvic testing.
locators: 1.4 chest; 1.5 haemorrhage and imaging; updates checked at source | Recommendations 5,8,11,13,18; physiology, imaging, coagulation, TBI exception, temperature | Figs.1,5; case-specific masking example

claim_zh: 报告束带是否在位、检查时的生理和未回答的问题。表面复位不能独立排除骨盆环损伤。
claim_en: Report binder status, physiology at imaging and unresolved questions. Apparent reduction cannot independently exclude pelvic ring injury.
locators: 1.4 chest; 1.5 haemorrhage and imaging; updates checked at source | Recommendations 5,8,11,13,18; physiology, imaging, coagulation, TBI exception, temperature | Figs.1,5; case-specific masking example

claim_zh: 骨科、止血、复苏及进一步影像路径按生理与本地资源协同制定，束带移除需团队计划。
claim_en: Coordinate orthopaedic, haemorrhage-control, resuscitation and imaging pathways by physiology and local resources; binder removal requires a team plan.
locators: 1.4 chest; 1.5 haemorrhage and imaging; updates checked at source | Recommendations 5,8,11,13,18; physiology, imaging, coagulation, TBI exception, temperature | Figs.1,5; case-specific masking example

claim_zh: 到院前确认空间可达、监护可用、团队角色与求助路径；具体编制按本地流程。
claim_en: Before arrival confirm access, monitoring readiness, team roles and escalation paths; staffing follows local workflows.
locators: Systematic assessment; breathing; shock; referral | Team checks; critical transitions

claim_zh: 报告机制、已知生理变化、已做事项和未知信息，不把猜测写成观察事实。
claim_en: Report mechanism, known physiologic changes, completed actions and unknowns; do not turn assumptions into observations.
locators: Systematic assessment; breathing; shock; referral | Team checks; critical transitions

claim_zh: 核查帮助团队发现遗漏；立即威胁仍按优先级并行处理，交接后有人持续复评。
claim_en: Checks help identify omissions. Immediate threats remain prioritised and coordinated, with an assigned reassessment owner after handoff.
locators: Systematic assessment; breathing; shock; referral | Team checks; critical transitions

claim_zh: 转运讨论应包含所需救治能力、预警内容、交通与资源状态，而不是只列医院名字。
claim_en: Transport discussions include required care capability, pre-alert information, access and resources, not just a hospital name.
locators: Systematic assessment; breathing; shock; referral | Team checks; critical transitions

claim_zh: 连续传递机制、生命体征趋势、干预与反应、未解决问题以及下一责任人。
claim_en: Transmit mechanism, vital trends, interventions and responses, unresolved questions and the next responsible person.
locators: Systematic assessment; breathing; shock; referral | Team checks; critical transitions

claim_zh: 离开现场、到院和转科是重新评估的节点；“已经检查”不能代替当前状态。
claim_en: Departure, arrival and transfer between teams are reassessment points; completed tests do not replace current status.
locators: Systematic assessment; breathing; shock; referral | Team checks; critical transitions

claim_zh: 区分常规急诊分诊与大规模伤亡情境；说明需求、可用能力和安全约束怎样变化。
claim_en: Distinguish routine emergency triage from mass-casualty conditions; explain changes in demand, capacity and safety constraints.
locators: Routine and mass-casualty triage are different contexts | Systematic assessment; breathing; shock; referral

claim_zh: 伤情与资源都可能改变；记录优先级依据、去向和复评责任，不把首次标签当作永久结论。
claim_en: Both injury and resources can change. Record the rationale, destination and reassessment owner rather than treating the first tag as permanent.
locators: Routine and mass-casualty triage are different contexts | Systematic assessment; breathing; shock; referral

claim_zh: 按机构认可的分诊工具训练；图中的地区标签只作实物对照，不自动等同于 WHO IITT 颜色或类别。
